shots.name: Eagle Ascent and Cinder Isles
shots.description: Race over Merovar’s coastal summit to the Fire Veinhold, its glowing reservoir and the volcanic Cinder Isles.

shots.name: Fire Veinhold — Island Orbit
shots.description: Circle the dormant volcano to look back toward Merovar and its coastal mountains.

shots.name: Fire Veinhold — Emergency Alarms
shots.description: Warning beacons and industrial sirens announce an emergency across the fortress.

shots.name: Fire Veinhold — Bridge Rush
shots.description: Rush past the fortress and across its steel bridge toward Merovar.

shots.name: Fire Veinhold — Frozen Guards
shots.description: Ice-bound Carcovian guards reveal an unseen assault on the mainland approach.
